latest.name: Suno — v6-mini (free-tier music generation)
latest.short_verdict: Strong for trying complete AI song ideas free. The daily generation allowance is useful, but new free accounts cannot rely on regular downloads and free songs are non-commercial.
latest.what_it_does: Turns a text prompt, mood, genre or lyrics into a complete song with vocals and instrumentation. The free tier uses Suno v6-mini, a faster, lighter member of the v6 model family.
latest.why_try_it: It is easy to test a song concept without music-production skills: describe a genre, mood and subject, then generate a vocal or instrumental track. It is particularly useful for song sketches and creative experiments.
latest.free_tier: Free plan: 50 credits refresh daily; Suno says this is enough for up to 10 songs per day. The free model is v6-mini. Songs can be played and shared through Suno. No credit card is required to start a free account.
latest.limits: Free outputs have no commercial-use rights. The free plan has no monthly song downloads. Users who joined before 3 September 2026 may have up to 7 lifetime trial downloads; users joining on or after that date may only occasionally receive trial downloads, so a new account should not expect regular file exports. Free users also use a shared creation queue and do not get stem separation. Songs remain playable and shareable on Suno.
latest.signup_pakistan: An account is required. Suno's help centre lists Google, Apple, Microsoft, Discord and phone-number sign-in. No official public country-availability list or live Pakistan signup test was found, so Pakistan-specific access is not confirmed. A free account does not require a credit card according to Suno's current product page.
latest.quality_evidence: Suno's official v6 announcement describes v6-mini as the faster, more efficient free-access model and says the v6 family supports full song creation and up to 8 minutes per generation. The official Google Play listing describes text-prompt, lyrics, humming and audio-input workflows; it showed 4.8/5 from about 2.1 million reviews and 10M+ downloads when checked. App ratings and adoption are practical product signals, not a controlled model benchmark. No independent benchmark specific to v6-mini was found.
latest.android_status: Official Android app verified; Google Play identifies the developer as Suno, Inc. Pakistan-specific Play Store availability was not independently tested.
latest.optional_upgrade_note: Optional paid upgrades provide more downloads and commercial-use rights; they are not part of this free recommendation.
